searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he first pass readback and delta the awtsmoos reveals not only what was written, but what the written vessel still conceals; awtsmoos.com becomes trustworthy when every planned promise is compared against what the filesystem actually reveals. original plan — complete reconstruction promises the final execution plan approved six complete file production rewrites: 1. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/index.html 2. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/hero.css 3. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/layout.css 4. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/discovery.css 5. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/responsive.css 6. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/mobile context.css the promised behavior was a compact identity masthead, unchanged search engine and ids, result first reading order, native context disclosure, responsive context demotion, no phone carousel, no accidental sticky pressure on short height screens, and no concurrent agent collision. what the first pass actually wrote all six approved files were rewritten completely and then reread in full. index.html now places identity → search task → scope/results → native library context details in source order. the old decorative hero mark and three truth badges were removed from markup. search input autofocus was removed so mobile users are not forced into an immediate virtual keyboard. every runtime required id from searchdom.js remains present. hero.css reduces the old 19rem billboard to a compact masthead and quieter trust line. layout.css removes the permanent desktop discovery column and gives results the primary reading width. discovery.css turns lanes/history/help into content under a native details disclosure. responsive.css makes context two columns at medium desktop, one column at tablet, and disables sticky search pressure on short height wide viewports. mobile context.css removes the old 86vw horizontal carousel and uses normal one column flow. search controllers, apis, provenance logic, history logic, result rendering, shared civilization styles, and dirty concurrent screenshot families were not modified. direct line census evidence index.html: 89 lines hero.css: 84 lines layout.css: 113 lines discovery.css: 112 lines responsive.css: 48 lines mobile context.css: 30 lines preserved mobile.css: 115 lines every current file remains beneath the 120 line hard ceiling. delta — what the readback found missing delta 1 — html readability the first entry rewrite still compresses several option/link/result/context subtrees onto single lines. behavior is clear, but this does not fully honor the repository law against cramped source. a second complete rewrite of index.html must expand those structures while staying below 120 lines. delta 2 — explicit focus visible proof hero.css and discovery.css currently use combined hover/focus visible rules that set outline: none. the shared base may provide other focus treatment, but a touched route local stylesheet must not depend on inference for keyboard visibility. second pass complete rewrites must provide explicit focus visible rings for scope links, context summary, and context card buttons. delta 3 — mobile import cache boundary mobile.css imports ./mobile context.css without a version query. the child stylesheet changed, so a browser or intermediary may legally reuse a stale cached import even when the html changed other stylesheet versions. a second pass complete rewrite of mobile.css must version that import, and index.html must version the parent stylesheet link. delta 4 — dead mobile selectors created by the new markup the preserved mobile.css still contains rules for .library hero mark, .library truth row, and .library hero copy; those structures were intentionally removed in the new entry markup. leaving them would create immediate technical debt. the complete mobile.css rewrite must remove only these now invalid responsibilities while preserving its safe area, one column form, scope scrolling, and result readability behavior. second pass production write set the discovered delta expands the write boundary to four complete files: 1. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/index.html — readable structure + cache version references. 2. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/hero.css — explicit keyboard focus ring. 3. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/discovery.css — explicit context/button focus rings. 4. geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/styles/mobile.css — version child import and retire selectors invalidated by the new markup. layout.css, responsive.css, and mobile context.css already match the final plan and need no second source rewrite unless later runtime evidence disproves them. second pass completion prompt rewrite the four delta files completely. do not partially replace text. keep tabs and readable newlines. keep every source file below 120 lines. re read all seven production files involved across both passes afterward, then compare original plan → first pass → second pass before running tests. next action perform the four complete file second pass rewrites, beginning with readable/cache versioned index.html, then focus safe css and the cleaned mobile owner.
